name: attila-toolkit
description: Total War: Attila modding: RPFM pack editing through rpfm_server's MCP (auto-started), DB/loc/Lua/startpos knowledge, audits for campaign events, AI and battle tiles, crash-dump analysis, file format specs and the engine type header.

attila_dir.title: Total War: ATTILA folder
attila_dir.description: The folder that holds Attila.exe and the data folder. Leave blank to auto-detect it from your Steam libraries.

rpfm_dir.title: RPFM folder
rpfm_dir.description: The folder that holds rpfm_cli and rpfm_server (RPFM 4.x release). Leave blank to auto-detect (PATH, Downloads, Desktop, Program Files ...).

work_dir.title: Work folder (optional)
work_dir.description: Short folder for extracted packs and reports. Keep the path short (Windows MAX_PATH). Blank = a folder named attila_work in the system temp area.

mod_packs.title: Mod packs to analyse (optional)
mod_packs.description: Semicolon-separated pack file names from the game's data folder that the audit scripts treat as your mod, e.g. my_mod.pack;my_mod_text.pack. Blank = the enabled tdd_pack*.pack files (The Dawnless Days).

rpfm_autostart.title: Start rpfm_server automatically
rpfm_autostart.description: Launch rpfm_server in the background when the RPFM MCP is used, and stop it when the last session ends (only if the toolkit started it).
